canonical_name: Spirited Improv (SPARK Creative Wellness Studio, LLC)
summary: Spirited Improv is a paid 6-week playshop series ("Sacred Playshop" / nighttime series) run by a single facilitator, expressive arts therapist Jessica Chilton, operating as SPARK Creative Wellness Studio, LLC, held at 83 Sanctuary Road in Swannanoa. It is structured and marketed as a commercial class series (registration fee, work-trade option) rather than a self-organized club, though the site notes many participants return across series and "deepen into the Spirited Improv community over the years." Could not confirm any independent Meetup group ("Awakening Asheville") actually hosting or affiliated with this series; the group's Meetup page could not be located.

evidence.note: Listing gives no description text beyond a short marketing summary; no membership language, no linked Facebook/Meetup/Instagram, tags read as workshop/retreat terms (Improv Workshop, Retreat Center, Group Facilitation).
Page identifies the organizer as Jessica Chilton, an expressive arts therapist with 20+ years of improv performance and 16 years of therapeutic practice; points to spiritedimprov.com.

Site frames Spirited Improv as instructor-led, paid 6-week group series ($225, $180 early-bird, work-trade available), run by one facilitator under SPARK Creative Wellness Studio, LLC — matches the 'class taught by a business' exclusion.

Site does say many participants continue from series to series and 'deepen into the Spirited Improv community over the years,' the strongest evidence for a returning core, but this is business-marketing language rather than a self-identified independent community.

The 'Awakening Asheville' Meetup URL returns a 'group not found' error; could not verify the assignment's note about a Meetup listing for a 'Spirited Improv Community Playshop,' and no working alternate URL was found via Bing/DuckDuckGo (Google/DDG results were not usefully renderable; WebSearch tool was unavailable, budget exhausted for the session).
